Description

The athletics track at Woodcote High School in Coulsdon is available to hire, offering a reliable and well-maintained outdoor space for a wide range of sporting and fitness activities. Ideal for running clubs, personal training sessions, school use, or casual fitness groups, the track provides a safe and spacious environment suited to both structured training and informal exercise.

Located within the school grounds, the facility benefits from a quiet and secure setting while remaining easily accessible for local users in and around Coulsdon. The surrounding open space also allows for warm-ups, drills, and group fitness activities, making it a versatile option for different types of bookings.

Flexible hire options are available, including evenings and weekends, making it convenient for both regular sessions and one-off bookings. Whether you’re preparing for competition, running a club session, or simply looking for a dedicated place to train, this athletics track offers a practical and accessible solution.
